g.text: TPS62162 from SYS. Supplies module, logic, microSD and ADC DVDD. BUCK_PG is informational; DIGITAL_OK supervises.

g.desc: TPS62162 from SYS. Supplies module, logic, microSD and ADC DVDD. BUCK_PG is informational; DIGITAL_OK supervises.

g.text: TPS62162 runs whenever SYS is up: from the pack, or from USB through the charger. Soft-off is the BQ25798 ship mode (charger sheet), which removes SYS entirely.

g.desc: TPS62162 runs whenever SYS is up: from the pack, or from USB through the charger. Soft-off is the BQ25798 ship mode (charger sheet), which removes SYS entirely.

g.text: Pull-downs keep reserved MCU outputs (charge request, power hold, LED, SD power) defined until those circuits exist.
